# Pipeline and external service failures

<small>Source: [`R/errors-operations.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/r-dataexcept/blob/main/R/errors-operations.R) · Help: `?pipeline_errors`</small>

Errors raised by a pipeline step: a call to another service that failed,
timed out, or was refused; an operation retried until the limit; and a read
or write to storage that failed. All inherit from
`dataexcept_pipeline_error`, and the four service errors from
`dataexcept_external_service_error` too.

## Usage

```r
external_service_error(
  service_name,
  status_code = NULL,
  response = NULL,
  message = NULL,
  parent = NULL,
  call = NULL
)

service_timeout_error(
  service_name,
  timeout_seconds = NULL,
  parent = NULL,
  call = NULL
)

service_authentication_error(
  service_name,
  message = NULL,
  parent = NULL,
  call = NULL
)

service_authorization_error(
  service_name,
  message = NULL,
  parent = NULL,
  call = NULL
)

retry_limit_exceeded_error(
  operation,
  retries,
  message = NULL,
  parent = NULL,
  call = NULL
)

storage_error(location, operation, message = NULL, parent = NULL, call = NULL)
```

## Arguments

`service_name`
:   Name of the service called.

`status_code`
:   The HTTP status code, if a response arrived.

`response`
:   The response, or part of it, stored as given. The envelope
    writes it as an attribute, so store only what is safe to log.

`message`
:   A message to use instead of the default.

`parent`
:   The condition that caused this one, or `NULL`.

`call`
:   The call to report, or `NULL`.

`timeout_seconds`
:   The time limit that elapsed, in seconds, or `NULL`.

`operation`
:   For `retry_limit_exceeded_error()`, the operation retried.
    For `storage_error()`, what was being done, such as `"write"`.

`retries`
:   Number of attempts made.

`location`
:   Where the data was stored, such as a path or a bucket URL.
    A URL is redacted.

## Value

A condition inheriting from `dataexcept_pipeline_error`.

## Details

A refused credential or permission will be refused again, so
`service_authentication_error()` and `service_authorization_error()` are
permanent and not retryable. The others are `"unknown"`: whether a retry
would help depends on the service, and [`with_failure_metadata()`](failure_metadata.md) records
what it said.

## Examples

```r
call_rates_api <- function(status) {
  if (status == 401L) stop(service_authentication_error("rates-api"))
  if (status >= 500L) stop(external_service_error("rates-api", status_code = status))
  "ok"
}

err <- tryCatch(call_rates_api(401L), dataexcept_external_service_error = identity)
conditionMessage(err)
is_retryable(err)

err <- tryCatch(call_rates_api(503L), dataexcept_external_service_error = identity)
is_retryable(err)

storage_error("s3://reports/2026/q3.parquet", "write")
```
